title: Prepare a change to an existing Odoo customer
intent: Fill new values into one existing customer's own form after the user confirms, and leave saving to the user.
instructions: Only an existing customer is edited this way. Read the customer first, with query_customers, and use the exact record_id it returns; never guess an id from a name.
Call prepare_customer_edit_form with that record_id and only the fields the user asked to change. Never invent a value, and never include a field the user did not name.
After a successful result, call prefill_form with no arguments. The server shows the user a confirmation naming the old and new values, and only then types them into the form.
Nothing is saved by this path. Odoo saves the open form when the page is left, so stop after prefill_form: never click, submit, invoke a mutation, or say the change was saved.
If the confirmation is declined or expires, nothing was typed. Say so plainly and do not retry the same values unasked.
